penalties.details: Receipt of a Spot/Audit Memo issued under Section 65 of the CGST Act, 2017, highlighting observations relating to short reversal of ITC in GSTR-3B vis-à-vis GSTR-9 and an unreconciled ITC difference in GSTR-9, and requesting deposit of applicable tax, interest and penalty.
penalties.impact: A penalty of INR 1,170.60 was levied. The Company has deposited the applicable tax, interest, and penalty pursuant to the observations communicated in the Spot/Audit Memo. Considering the nominal amount involved, there is no material impact on the financial position, operations, or other activities of the Company.

timeline.summary: Indiqube Spaces Limited schedules **Q4 FY2026 earnings call** with **Rishi Das (Chairman & CEO), Meghna Agarwal (Co-Founder & COO), Pawan Jain (CFO), Vikas Agrawal (Head-IR), Vamsi Chatrathi (AVP-Marketing)** on **May 21, 2026 at 2:00 PM (IST)**.
Indiqube Spaces Limited’s **Pawan Jaichandbhai Jain (CFO)** schedules Analyst/Investor meet on **May 22, 2026, 09:00 AM IST** at Centrum, Mumbai.
Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹401.45 Cr, net loss ₹22.65 Cr.
Indiqube Spaces Limited hosted an Investors/Analysts call on May 21, 2026, to discuss Q4FY26 and FY26 results; audio recording available at https://indiqube.com/investor/financials/.
IndiQube Spaces signed a ₹52 crore workspace deal for over 700 seats in Yelahanka, Bengaluru.
Indiqube Spaces approved an investment of up to ₹35 crore for a 49% stake in SaiEdge Realty Private Limited.
Earnings conference call on financial performance of Indiqube Spaces Limited for quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 scheduled on Wednesday, November 04, 2026 at 02:00 P.M. (IST).
